overview: An Amazon-style product catalog with featured homepage, product listing grid with filters, and detailed product pages — all styled with white backgrounds and orange accents.
features: Products database with full catalog fields (title, price, sale price, images, category, brand, SKU, rating)
Homepage with hero banner, featured products grid, category navigation row, and deals section
Product listing page with grid view, category filtering, and sort options
Product detail page with image gallery, sale price strikethrough, stock status, quantity selector, Add to Cart and Buy Now
Amazon-inspired design: white background, orange (#FF9900) accent color
